US Judge Blocks Trump Election Order and Immigration Arrests

A US judge has blocked an executive order by President Trump that required proof of citizenship for voter registration. The judge ruled that the Constitution does not grant the president such powers, assigning election regulation authority to states and Congress. Separately, the same judge barred immigration arrests at US courthouses, seen as a setback for the Trump administration.
